notes.title: Happy birthday, Only Climb: Better Together!
notes.notes: [h1]Dear friends,[/h1][p]We are thrilled to share some exciting news: today, our beloved game [i]Only Climb: Better Together[/i] turns two years old! Over these two years, we’ve watched together as players from all over the world fall in love with the game, eagerly await each update, conquer new thrilling and challenging maps, and return time and again to familiar tracks to beat their personal records.[/p][p]We are sincerely grateful to each of you for your support, warmth, and love for our game. It’s truly a joy to be part of the big, friendly [i]Only Climb[/i] family that has united us for two years. We promise to keep improving the game, making it better, more engaging, and more diverse with each passing year.[/p][p]We’re also excited to announce that a beta branch for a new update will open soon! We’ll keep you updated on all events and news.[/p][h3]Happy birthday, [i]Only Climb: Better Together[/i]![/h3][p][/p][p][b]With respect and gratitude,[/b][/p][p][b]The Exbyte Studios Development Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Devlog №5 Announcement of Work on the Custom Map Editor and New Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Announcement of Work on the Custom Map Editor and New Update[/h1]

[h1]Dear Players![/h1]

The Only Climb: Better Together development team is pleased to announce the start of work on one of the key features that will significantly expand the game’s possibilities – the custom map editor. This tool will allow the community to independently create unique climbing routes, share them via the Workshop platform, and organize gaming sessions using their own creations.

[h1]Key Features of the Editor:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Map Creation: Players will be able to design routes of any complexity, using a wide range of tools to bring their ideas to life – from massive towering structures to intricate obstacles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358703/07cdc844e61cee1e885f588cc7235202030c0ebf.png[/img]

[*] Workshop Integration: Completed maps can be published in the Workshop, giving other users the opportunity to download, rate, and test them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358703/0737f5e240ce4f9f2371d94e0ecc9ddb50af71e2.png[/img]

[*] Support for Co-op Play: A feature will be added to create gaming sessions using custom maps, opening new horizons for cooperative and competitive interaction.
[/list]

[i]At the moment, the team is focused on developing an intuitive interface and functional tools for the editor to ensure ease of use and a high level of creative freedom. We are actively testing the system and refining its key components to deliver a stable and high-quality product to you in the future.[/i]

[h1]In addition, with the release of the new update, we are excited to announce the following additions:[/h1]

[b]New Skyway Map:[/b] A unique route with breathtaking views and fresh challenges for height enthusiasts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358703/74e991dcea022e8120f2b17e01d67ee3892bd908.png[/img]

[b]New DLCs:[/b] Additional content packs that will enhance your gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358703/6c69650b9a3bc51eac87175e0b61d313c9f1441c.png[/img]

[b]Collectible Cards:[/b] Exclusive digital items for your collection, available as part of the update.

[b]Inventory Items:[/b] New customization elements that will let you stand out among other climbers.

We will keep you updated on the development progress and inform you about the next stages in upcoming announcements. We invite you to share your suggestions and ideas regarding the editor and new content through our official communication channels – your feedback plays a vital role in improving the project.

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]

[b]Sincerely,

The Only Climb Development Team[/b]

notes.title: ASTROLIFT TERMINAL - NEW MAP ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
Hello, players!

We are excited to announce a new update for the game Only Climb: Better Together. Introducing our new map - Astrolift Terminal!

Astrolift Terminal is an exciting and high-tech location, situated in the heart of the upper layers of the planet's atmosphere. Above, there's only space and endless journeys to different planets. Get ready for new challenges and unique opportunities that this map offers.

In Astrolift Terminal, you will experience new vertical tracks filled with thrilling obstacles and difficult hurdles. You'll have to overcome gravitational fields, magnetic barriers, and other unique elements that make this map special. Every step will test your endurance, agility, and coordination. Along the way, you'll encounter robots that will hinder your progress and push you down.

Coming soon:

Astrolift Terminal also offers new multiplayer modes that will allow you to compete against other players in exciting races. Play in race mode, where your goal is to be the first to reach the finish line.

We have also added new elements and improvements to make the game even more thrilling. Earn achievements, unlock new characters, and customize their appearance to showcase your style.

Astrolift Terminal is a new chapter in the story of Only Climb: Better Together. Join us and show off your skills in this exciting new map!

notes.title: NEW MAP UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h1]Update:[/h1]

[h1]New Map: [/h1]
We have added a new map called Pirate Island. Continue your journey to the unknown heights with the new map, which is a continuation of the story of people climbing up to the heights of perfection. Once you have completed the first map, you will find yourself on a pirate island where pirates trade their loot and keep their treasures. You can start the map solo or with friends. On the way up, you can pick up different kinds of water pistols to stop your rivals from getting ahead. However, be cautious, as the water pistols can toss you in a random direction and hinder your climb. This map has fewer elevators and shortcuts, and there are fewer garbage cans. You will have to go through the whole path on your own.

[h1]New Mechanics: [/h1]
We have added water pistols with limited charges. Try to hit your rivals and toss them in a random direction. This may shorten your journey, but it can also make your climb more challenging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358703/2fffc5fee1e1270db17076729dca50314103ea88.gif[/img]

Swimming: We are excited to introduce a new feature in our game - the Swimming System! What better way to explore the beautiful Pirate Island than by taking a refreshing swim in the crystal-clear waters of the high seas?

[h1]Vehicle Driving: [/h1]
We have added driving in its first iteration, but it is still subject to change. Currently, the vehicles don't function as they should, but you can still try them out on the pirate island by finding a police car or an ambulance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358703/e9bf0b01c2c8bac5988b315f32b8b23e704d4777.png[/img]

New Character and Accessories: We have added a new character called Pirate, along with a Pirate Hat, which is only available on the Pirate Island map.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1] 
We have fixed the bug that was preventing players from receiving an achievement.
We have resolved an issue that caused difficulties in connecting to servers. Furthermore, we have improved the optimization of network games.

[h1]Misc:[/h1]
The maximum number of players has been increased to 10.

notes.title: Unable to join a lobby or create a server - SOLVED
notes.notes: Okay, guys. The problem of not being able to create a lobby and connect is solved. First, you close the game. Then go through Windows search to %appdata%, then step back to the "AppData" folder and then follow the path to the Local folder. In this folder you delete the "onlyclimbtogether" folder. After that restart the game and everything will work. If the same errors appear - delete the game and delete the folder. Reinstall the game and everything will work in the end.

notes.title: UPDATE ONLY CLIMB #3 v.1.0.2.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Here are some recent updates, bug fixes, and optimization improvements that have been made to the game:[/h1]

- Voice Chat has been added, allowing players to communicate in real-time.
- New Emotes have been added.
- The user interface has been redone for improved usability.
- A new networking system has been implemented.
- Game sessions are no longer region-locked, allowing players to connect from anywhere.

[h1]Bug fixes include:[/h1]

- Character controls have been improved for easier obstacle climbing.
- Lobby connectivity issues have been fixed.
- Client-side gameplay issues have been resolved, making player movement smoother.

[h1]Optimization improvements include:[/h1]

- Big optimization work has been done on the classic map for better performance on low-end computers. Players can adjust "View distance" and "Post Process Quality" to the lowest settings for optimal results.
- Fewer freezes occur when looking up with "View distance" set to the minimum.
- The game now runs smoother with fewer freezes and stutters.
- The game now takes up less space on players' drives.

notes.title: OPTIMIZATION UPDATE Only Climb #2
notes.notes:
[h1]WORK ON OPTIMIZATION[/h1] 

Optimization work has been done. We continue to reduce the load on medium and low-end computers. Now there are fewer problems with FPS drops. Using optimizing methods we have managed to achieve stabilization of the game's FPS. 

To achieve maximum FPS, in the main menu you should set the "Effects" setting to "low". Also, do not forget to lower the setting of the drawing distance. These settings work in the main menu or lobby before starting a game session.

Working on stabilizing multiplayer.

[h1]ERROR FIXES[/h1]

We've worked on fixing bugs that were causing the game to be impossible to complete to the very end. We have fixed collision problems at the level with trains.

[h1]NEW OPPORTUNITIES[/h1]
Added the first iteration of Spectator mode. We continue to work on the tournament mode and at the moment it is possible to use the Spectator mode on "L".


Changed graphics settings. The Cinematic mode of graphics has been added. For high-end computers added additional details in the game. 

Added FPS limits. 30, 60, 90, 120. Now it will be more convenient for you to limit fps in the game. 


Thank you very much for your help! We have a very active and supportive community! We continue to work for you!

notes.title: UPDATE #1
notes.notes:
Our latest update introduces some new settings and changes to the game mechanics. Here's what you can expect:

Added Settings:
- Adjust your mouse sensitivity to your liking
- Turn Day&Night cycle on or off, depending on your preferences. If you don't like playing at night, simply switch it off in the lobby settings
- Now you can make your lobbies for friends only, they will not be listed in the server list, your friends can join via steam overlay

Changes to the Game Mechanics:
- We have temporarily removed Ragdoll from the game
- Rolling up now works on CTRL instead of ALT, as it was before

Game Map Changes:
- We have continued to work on improving the map levels
- New dumpsters (skips) have been added
- Some dumpsters (skips) that were not functioning properly have been removed

Work in Progress (WIP):
- We are currently working on saving game settings
- We are expanding the game map and adding new ways to progress through the game
- We are improving the stability of game lobbies
- We are optimizing the game for a better overall experience

We hope you enjoy these updates and thank you for playing!

notes.title: Announcement of bug fixes №1
notes.notes: Hello everyone! We greatly appreciate your feedback, and we're hard at work fixing any bugs and errors within the game. Our main focus is improving the stability of the multiplayer experience, as well as fixing object collisions that may prevent players from progressing through the game. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Only Climb: Better Together is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're thrilled to share that Only Climb: Better Together! has been successfully launched on Steam. We'd like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who supported and assisted us during the development stage.

We're currently working on enhancing the game map, ensuring its playability and delivering an improved gameplay experience. In case you come across any bugs or issues while playing, please inform us via the form available on Discord or the Steam forum.

The complete game functionality is accessible on the Steam page.

We wish you all an enjoyable and successful gaming experience! Remember to stay calm and composed, and we're confident you'll arise as winners.

Best regards,
Exbyte Studios!
